warnings: Grid bubbles are printed on every structural plan: 1-9 along x (8 bays x 4.50 = 36.00, total printed) and A-C along y (A-B 6.00, B-C 3.00, total 9.00). Origin A1 (top-left as drawn). All four plans (S-01..S-04) agree on these values.

Dummy lines: every printed tick on the five structural plans is a line (§4 rule 4). y before origin and in the A-B gap share A's prime sequence in reading order: A' -1.60 (eave), A'' -1.23 (GS slab edge), A''' -0.83 (corridor slab S2 edge, printed '~0.83'), A'''' 2.40, A''''' 3.00 (B4 beam line), A'''''' 4.50. B-C gap: B' 6.60, B'' 7.60 (truss reinforcement-lap tick, S-05), B''' 8.27 (B5 line, '~0.73' above C). After C: C' 9.73 (S1 edge, '~0.73'), C'' 10.60 (eave). x: 1' -1.20 (eave), 1'' -1.18 (GS edge), 1''' -0.68 (S1 edge, '~0.68'); 9' 36.68, 9'' 37.20 (eave).

1' (-1.20, eave line on S-04) and 1'' (-1.18, GS ground-slab edge on S-02) are 0.02 apart. They are different edges printed on different sheets (eave vs ground slab), so both are kept per §4 rule 4, not merged.
Several values are printed with a tilde ('~0.83', '~0.73', '~0.68') — the drawing itself marks them approximate. pos_m uses the printed number.

9' (36.68) is NOT printed: it is the end of the short cantilever BC at B9 on floors 1-2, scaled from the drawing (~0.68) and matching the printed '~0.68' on the grid-1 side (1'''). Kept as a scaled dummy with its own confidence so the BC stub has an endpoint (beam-endpoint rule). C' (9.73) is printed on S-04 (S1 slab edge); the BC stubs at C2/C8 on floors 1-2 scale to ~0.70 and are recorded against C'.

z_levels: the only labelled level is the ±0.00 building datum (S-01 note). Every other level is a member-top value printed in brackets next to a beam/slab mark on the plans (+0.10 ... +7.17) — ids are the printed value, type dummy.

Dimension sweep covers the five structural plans S-01..S-05 (pages 17-21) plus the truss elevations of S-06 (page 22), the level marks of S-12 (page 28) and the stair elevations of S-13 (page 29, x ticks 1'''' 1.22 / 1''''' 1.60 / 1'''''' 1.68 / 1''''''' 4.30 from grid 1 — drawn for the grid 1-2 stair only; the mirrored grid 8-9 stair prints none). The architectural sheets (A-01..A-15) and the detail sheets S-07..S-11 were not swept for grid ticks in this op04 run (shutdown deadline) — their dimensions are not in this file (element-internal dimensions of the extracted detail sheets live on their elements). The two beam-spacing rows of S-12's 'ขยายระดับ พื้นและคาน' (2.35/3.05/3.10 and 3.05/3.05/3.10, measured between beam faces/edges that do not add up to the 9.00 grid) are kept as unpositioned 'edge' chains rather than guessed onto lines. The stair tread note on S-02/S-03 ('20 x 0.18 = ...', too small to read reliably at this scan) is likewise not transcribed. The rest of A-01..A-15 and the detail sheets S-07 / S-08 / S-10 / S-11 are still not swept for grid ticks.]
Scanned CAD-plotted government set (กองออกแบบและก่อสร้าง สำนักอำนวยการ สพฐ.); every value was read off zoomed crops of the page images.

2026-10-22 resume run — S-09 (หน้า25) 'ตัวอย่างการเสริมเหล็กเสา LineA-5' (No,Scale) prints three clear heights between beam faces: H=0.87 / 2.15 / 2.85 (plus an unvalued 'H' from the footing to floor 1, not recorded). Each was anchored on a printed level and its far end added as a dummy z level (§4 rule 4, z axis): +0.15 (B1 top, S-12) + 2.85 = +3.00; +3.70 (B1 top, S-12) + 2.15 = +5.85; +6.10 (RB3 top, S-04) + 0.87 = +6.97. All three far ends independently equal a printed level minus a printed section depth (3.70 − B1 0.70, 6.10 − RB3 0.25, 7.17 − RB1 0.20), so the anchoring is checked, not assumed — and it confirms RB3's +6.10 at grid 5, which S-04 prints only on the end bays. The heights run from the deepest beam at each joint (B1, 0.30x0.70), as the sheet itself says ('นับระยะ lo จากหน้าตัดคานที่ลึกสุด'); anchoring H=2.15 on B3A (+3.65) instead would put RB3's soffit at 5.80, which no section depth supports. Risk accepted: the sheet is a No-Scale example, so the three levels carry confidence 0.75. The '▽ คานหลังคา / คานชั้น 2 / คานชั้น 1' markers print no value, and the tie-zone ticks (0.50 lo, 5 Cm, 0.075 / 0.15) are element-internal (§4 rule 4) — they stay on the S-09 section element.

2026-10-22 resume run — datum ambiguity, recorded not resolved: A-03 (หน้า04) item 1 and the S-01 note set ±0.00 at the natural ground / nearby road level with the fill raised ~0.30 m above it (z +0.30, now also a z chain from A-03), but A-03 item 2 says building levels reference 0.00 at the top of the compacted fill, and S-12's GS detail labels '▽ +0.00(ระดับดินถม)'. Two statements each way. No level value was changed: every member level in this file is the bracketed value printed on the structural plans, measured from the building's ±0.00 whatever its physical position on site; the +0.30 line stays as printed. A-03's 2 m fill width went to unassigned_dimensions (measured from the building, on no grid line).

2026-10-22 resume run — the other newly read views print only element-internal dimensions and add no line: S-05 plates (0.25x0.25 plate, ≥ 0.25 embedment, 0.35 / 0.45 column head), S-06 ขยาย 2/3 (stub post 0.20, truss-soffit clearance ~0.12 / ~0.14 — the same 0.12 S-04 prints, already in unassigned_dimensions), S-12 lintel 0.15x0.20 / sill band 0.10 / corbel 0.10-0.05-0.10.
